velocity_note: Points per two-week sprint for a standard team of 5 (2 engineers, 1 data/AI engineer, 1 analyst, 1 lead); replace with measured velocity after sprint 2.

reference_stories.story: As an employee, I want my Exchange mailbox migrated with mail, calendar and contacts, so that I lose nothing at cutover.
As an IT admin, I want users and groups synced from Active Directory, so that accounts are provisioned automatically.
As an employee, I want single sign-on with 2-Step Verification, so that I sign in securely once.
As a team lead, I want department file shares moved to shared drives with the right permissions, so that my team finds files in one place.
As a compliance officer, I want DLP rules that block sharing of policy numbers and SSNs outside the company, so that PII does not leak.
As a claims adjuster, I want a summary of the claim file with key dates, amounts and open tasks, so that I understand a claim in under a minute.
As a claims handler, I want the assistant to draft the customer letter for my review, so that I spend less time writing.
As a reviewer, I want a queue of AI-drafted outputs to approve or reject with a reason, so that a human decides every customer-facing action.
As a field technician, I want today's work orders available offline on my phone, so that I can work without coverage.
As a field technician, I want to capture photos and attach them to the work order, so that evidence is recorded on site.
As an operations manager, I want a dashboard of KPIs refreshed daily, so that I can spot problems early.
As a data engineer, I want a daily pipeline that loads source extracts into BigQuery, so that analytics use fresh data.
As a store manager, I want a 14-day demand forecast per SKU, so that I order the right stock.
As a citizen, I want to report an issue through WhatsApp and get a tracking number, so that I know it was received.
As an employee, I want to ask questions about policies and get cited answers from the knowledge base, so that I don't wait for an expert.
As a user, I want an email notification when the status of my request changes, so that I don't need to check manually.
As an administrator, I want role-based access to the admin screens, so that only authorised staff change settings.
As a sales rep, I want order status synced from the ERP to the CRM, so that I answer customers without calling the warehouse.
